intro.title: Color Picker
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple color picker application using React and TypeScript. You will learn how to use the useState hook to manage the currently selected color as a piece of component state. The main technologies involved are React functional components, TypeScript for type safety, and basic HTML input elements. By the end, you will have a working app that displays a color and allows the user to change it with a click.
intro.usecase: Color pickers are essential UI components in design tools, content management systems, and customization interfaces. You'll find them in products like Figma and Canva for selecting design elements, in WordPress themes for customizing website colors, and in e-commerce platforms for personalizing products. As a developer, you'll implement color pickers when building admin dashboards with theme settings, form builders with styling options, or any application that requires visual customization by users. These components bridge user preferences with application theming systems.
